points.label: McDougall Pond outer basin
points.identity_evidence: Single broad pond behind Bay St Lawrence shore, immediately south of fishing-station road and west of the road curving around its east side. Neck toward bay and pointed southern lobe correspond. Basin closed across the narrow northern throat on both sources; modern river-mouth closure segments retained as source-defined geometry.

points.label: Warren Lake outer basin
points.identity_evidence: Long Warren Lake, eastward outlet to Ingonish road and ocean, northern tributary with falls and southern road around basin. Distinct broad northwest lobe and north-shore notch match modern outline. Incoming and outgoing streams excluded.

points.label: Ingonish Island outer coastline
points.identity_evidence: The isolated island east of Jackson Point and the Ingonish coastal settlement, north of Middle Head. Rounded southern body and indented northern margin agree; lighthouse/road symbols excluded. Distinct from offshore eastern rocks.

points.label: Lake of Islands outer basin
points.identity_evidence: Interior Lake of Islands draining east through Barron Brook toward Warren Lake, with north narrow arm, westward inlet, broad southern body and several islands. Modern islands differ in detail and number; outer basin centroid avoids assigning uncertain individual islets. Separate from the two July North Pond checks.
